``` sql
SELECT users.id AS `users__id` FROM users users LIMIT 2
```

I took a quick look at this issue. Was unable to reproduce it, but looking at this code I could imagine it going wrong. In my opinion there should be a better check to see if `$parts` is empty, the `count()` above is insufficient.
